name: Raw Celery Sticks (Stringy Insoluble Fiber Warning)
whyItWorks: Celery stalks contain long, longitudinal vascular bundles (the fibrous 'strings') composed of tough collenchyma and lignin. When swallowed, these strings do not dissolve, balling up into a fibrous mass (phytobezoar) that can obstruct the terminal ileum.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture Warning: Avoid raw celery sticks and celery crudité. If cooking with celery (mirpoix/soups), dice extremely fine and cook until translucent and soft.
watchOuts: Fibrous celery strings tangle together in the GI tract, posing an acute blockage risk in Crohn's patients with strictures.
